_note: PLACEHOLDER prices. Costs deliberately mix essence with raw resources — before this file existed, ore and fibre had no sink at all and just piled up in the Storehouse. 'ranks' is one entry per purchase; an upgrade with three entries can be bought three times. Current rank is read from the state the upgrade actually changes (see EconomyRules.rank), never stored twice.
